prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo as the ONLY facial reference with strict identity preservation. Maintain the subject’s exact facial structure, proportions, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, and unique features with zero beautification or identity drift.
Create a cheerful, brightly lit, pastel-themed birthday portrait with a polished K-pop fan-event aesthetic. The subject stands centered, facing the camera directly, smiling warmly with teeth visible, holding a round birthday cake with both hands at chest level. Shoulders are relaxed, posture natural and elegant, and the pose, hand placement, camera angle, and framing must remain consistent.
The subject wears a modest light-blue princess-style dress with a fitted bodice and off-shoulder design, featuring sheer ruffled tulle sleeves. A matching light-blue beret with a small white two-trapezoid logo sits neatly on the head. Accessories include a pearl necklace and small dangling earrings. Hair is long, softly wavy, and neatly styled over the shoulders.
The cake is white with smooth frosting, “Happy Birthday” written in blue cursive icing, pastel pink and yellow decorations, and three lit candles. The background is a solid powder-blue wall with large puffy pink “HAPPY BIRTHDAY” letters, pastel blue and pink balloons, and white-and-blue triangular bunting. Cute fan-style cartoon cutouts and extra pastel decorations add a playful celebration vibe.
Lighting is soft, high-key, and evenly diffused with minimal shadows, producing clean, natural skin texture. Colors are airy and pastel, with sharp focus, gentle depth of field, and a premium studio finish.

Aspect ratio: 3:4 (portrait)

Negative Prompt
Do not change pose, framing, camera angle, or hand position.

No face alteration, identity drift, beautification, or generic AI features.

No nudity, cleavage emphasis, revealing clothing, or suggestive styling.

No anime, cartoon, 3D, CGI, plastic skin, or over-smoothing.

No harsh lighting, dark tones, neon colors, or oversaturation.

No missing or altered decorations, text errors, extra fingers, blur, noise, or artifacts.

prompts.title: Birthday Frames
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylish, vertically oriented (3:4) premium birthday digital collage using the uploaded reference photo, with STRICT facial identity preservation.

🔒 Face-Match Enforcement (Very Important)
The generated face must be 100% identical to the reference image
Use the reference image as the only facial source
Do not alter facial structure, proportions, skin tone, or hairline
Preserve natural skin texture, pores, and real facial details
No beautification, no face morphing, no stylization of facial features
Face must remain fully visible and unobstructed

Glasses must match natural proportions and sit realistically on the face

🧍 Central Subject (Main Portrait)
Young man sitting on the floor in a relaxed, confident pose
Body angled slightly to the right, face turned directly toward the camera
Left knee raised, left hand resting on it, clearly showing a silver watch with a dark dial
Right leg folded flat on the ground

Expression: bright, confident, joyful smile (birthday vibe)

Appearance

Natural Skin
Naturally styled hair
Well-groomed short beard (If available in reference image)
Thin wire-rim aviator-style glasses

Outfit
Oversized dark grey knit sweater with ribbed crew neck and cuffs
Dark trousers with vertical ribbed texture (corduroy-like), black or deep charcoal
Black leather Chelsea boots

🖼️ Background & Collage Inserts

Background: solid dark purple matte texture, deep violet tones
Subtle purple rim-light / haze on the subject’s left side (viewer’s left)
Soft floating dust / particle overlays for depth
Four Smaller Portrait Inserts (Floating Cluster – NOT a grid)

Positioned above and to the right of the main subject:
Top Right – smiling headshot, looking upward, framed with a torn paper edge

Middle Right – serious direct-gaze headshot, framed like a classic film negative

Middle Left (slightly tilted) – profile shot looking downward/sideways, framed inside a film strip

Bottom Right (of cluster) – smiling headshot with a glowing purple neon frame

Each insert must clearly depict the same person with perfect face match.

✨ Typography

Top left corner text: “Happy Birthday”

Style: neon-light typography, glowing purple with white highlights

Looks like a real neon sign mounted on a dark wall

Clean, modern, premium — not cartoonish

Overall mood: trendy, urban, sophisticated, premium birthday aesthetic

High clarity, cinematic lighting, professional poster-quality output

🚫 Negative Prompt (Highly Recommended)

blurry face, face distortion, incorrect facial features, different person, beautified skin, plastic skin, over-smooth skin, exaggerated beard, wrong glasses shape, cartoon style, anime, painterly style, low resolution, washed colors, messy collage, grid layout, duplicated faces, extra limbs, warped body, incorrect pose, text artifacts, misspelled text, watermark, logo

The central subject, who has styled brown hair, a short beard, and thin wire-rimmed glasses, sits in a relaxed pose with his left knee raised and hands clasped, displaying a silver watch. He wears a dark grey ribbed knit sweater, dark textured trousers, and black leather Chelsea boots, offering a warm, confident smile to the camera. In the upper left corner, "Happy Birthday" is written in a bright, glowing purple neon script. To the upper right, a creative collage of four smaller headshots displays the same man in various expressions—including a profile view and a direct gaze—framed by artistic elements like torn paper edges, film strips, and a neon border.
